topic: Word Formation: Verbs and nouns in English
title: Verbs and Their Nouns

explanation.tr:
Birçok fiilden isim türetilir. En sık sonekler:
• -tion / -sion: inform → information, decide → decision, invite → invitation
• -ment: move → movement, pay → payment, agree → agreement
• -er / -or (kişi): teach → teacher, drive → driver, act → actor
• -ance / -ence: perform → performance, exist → existence
• -al: arrive → arrival
Bazıları aynı kalır: a walk, a call, a dream, a visit.
Bazıları düzensizdir: choose → choice, die → death, lose → loss, think → thought.
explanation.tk:
Köp işliklerden at ýasalýar. Iň köp ulanylýan goşulmalar:
• -tion / -sion: inform → information, decide → decision, invite → invitation
• -ment: move → movement, pay → payment, agree → agreement
• -er / -or (adam): teach → teacher, drive → driver, act → actor
• -ance / -ence: perform → performance, exist → existence
• -al: arrive → arrival
Käbirleri üýtgemeýär: a walk, a call, a dream, a visit.
Käbirleri düzgünsiz: choose → choice, die → death, lose → loss, think → thought.
explanation.ru:
Из многих глаголов образуются существительные. Частые суффиксы:
• -tion / -sion: inform → information, decide → decision, invite → invitation
• -ment: move → movement, pay → payment, agree → agreement
• -er / -or (человек): teach → teacher, drive → driver, act → actor
• -ance / -ence: perform → performance, exist → existence
• -al: arrive → arrival
Некоторые не меняются: a walk, a call, a dream, a visit.
Некоторые неправильные: choose → choice, die → death, lose → loss, think → thought.

exercises.question: A person who teaches is a ___.
A person who acts in films is an ___.

explanation.tr:
Cümleyi anlamlı yapan fiildir. Doğru fiili seçmek için ismin ne yaptığını düşün:
• eat (yemek), drink (içmek), sleep (uyumak), read (okumak), write (yazmak)
• go (gitmek), come (gelmek), live (yaşamak), work (çalışmak), play (oynamak)
• wear (giymek), open (açmak), close (kapamak), cook (pişirmek), watch (izlemek)
He/she/it ile şimdiki genişte -s eklenir: She reads. He plays.
Kalıp eşleşmeleri: read a book, drink water, play football, watch TV, wear a coat.
explanation.tk:
Sözlemi manyly edýän işlik. Dogry işligi saýlamak üçin adyň näme edýändigini pikir ediň:
• eat (iýmek), drink (içmek), sleep (ýatmak), read (okamak), write (ýazmak)
• go (gitmek), come (gelmek), live (ýaşamak), work (işlemek), play (oýnamak)
• wear (geýmek), open (açmak), close (ýapmak), cook (bişirmek), watch (görmek)
He/she/it bilen häzirki zamanda -s goşulýar: She reads. He plays.
Durnukly jübütler: read a book, drink water, play football, watch TV, wear a coat.
explanation.ru:
Смысл предложению даёт глагол. Чтобы выбрать нужный, подумай, что делает предмет:
• eat (есть), drink (пить), sleep (спать), read (читать), write (писать)
• go (идти), come (приходить), live (жить), work (работать), play (играть)
• wear (носить), open (открывать), close (закрывать), cook (готовить), watch (смотреть)
С he/she/it в Present Simple добавляется -s: She reads. He plays.
Устойчивые пары: read a book, drink water, play football, watch TV, wear a coat.

topic: Word Formation: Word formation – Noun – Adjective
title: From Nouns to Adjectives

explanation.tr:
İsimden sıfat türeten sonekler:
• -ful (…lı, dolu): help → helpful, beauty → beautiful, care → careful
• -less (…sız): care → careless, home → homeless, hope → hopeless
• -y: sun → sunny, rain → rainy, salt → salty, health → healthy
• -ous: danger → dangerous, fame → famous
• -al: nature → natural, music → musical, nation → national
• -ly (sıfat!): friend → friendly, day → daily, love → lovely
• -ic: history → historic, artist → artistic
• -ish: child → childish, fool → foolish
explanation.tk:
Atdan sypat ýasaýan goşulmalar:
• -ful (…ly, doly): help → helpful, beauty → beautiful, care → careful
• -less (…syz): care → careless, home → homeless, hope → hopeless
• -y: sun → sunny, rain → rainy, salt → salty, health → healthy
• -ous: danger → dangerous, fame → famous
• -al: nature → natural, music → musical, nation → national
• -ly (sypat!): friend → friendly, day → daily, love → lovely
• -ic: history → historic, artist → artistic
• -ish: child → childish, fool → foolish
explanation.ru:
Суффиксы, образующие прилагательные от существительных:
• -ful (полный чего-то): help → helpful, beauty → beautiful, care → careful
• -less (без чего-то): care → careless, home → homeless, hope → hopeless
• -y: sun → sunny, rain → rainy, salt → salty, health → healthy
• -ous: danger → dangerous, fame → famous
• -al: nature → natural, music → musical, nation → national
• -ly (прилагательное!): friend → friendly, day → daily, love → lovely
• -ic: history → historic, artist → artistic
• -ish: child → childish, fool → foolish

topic: Word Formation: Word formation – Verb – Noun
title: Verb or Noun? Using the Right Form

explanation.tr:
Cümlede boşluğa fiil mi isim mi gerektiğini anlamak için:
• a/an/the/my/his… sonrası → İSİM: The explanation was clear.
• Sıfattan sonra → İSİM: a good decision
• Özne (I, she, they…) sonrası, to sonrası, can/will/must sonrası → FİİL: She will explain. I want to decide.
Sık çiftler: explain – explanation, describe – description, discuss – discussion, enjoy – enjoyment, improve – improvement, succeed – success, fail – failure, believe – belief, advise – advice, prove – proof
explanation.tk:
Sözlemde boşluga işlik ýa-da at gerekdigini bilmek üçin:
• a/an/the/my/his… soň → AT: The explanation was clear.
• Sypatdan soň → AT: a good decision
• Eýeden (I, she, they…), to, can/will/must soň → IŞLIK: She will explain. I want to decide.
Köp duş gelýän jübütler: explain – explanation, describe – description, discuss – discussion, enjoy – enjoyment, improve – improvement, succeed – success, fail – failure, believe – belief, advise – advice, prove – proof
explanation.ru:
Чтобы понять, нужен глагол или существительное:
• После a/an/the/my/his… → СУЩ.: The explanation was clear.
• После прилагательного → СУЩ.: a good decision
• После подлежащего (I, she, they…), to, can/will/must → ГЛАГОЛ: She will explain. I want to decide.
Частые пары: explain – explanation, describe – description, discuss – discussion, enjoy – enjoyment, improve – improvement, succeed – success, fail – failure, believe – belief, advise – advice, prove – proof

topic: Word Formation: Words with the ending -ing in English sentences
title: Words Ending in -ing: Verb, Noun or Adjective?

explanation.tr:
-ing ile biten kelimeler farklı görevler yapabilir:
• Fiil (continuous): She is SWIMMING now.
• İsim (gerund): SWIMMING is good for you. / I like READING.
• Sıfat: a BORING film, an INTERESTING book, RUNNING water
-ing sıfatı vs -ed sıfatı:
• -ing = bir şeyin etkisi: The film is boring (film sıkıcı).
• -ed = kişinin hissi: I am bored (ben sıkıldım).
Yazım: make → making, run → running, lie → lying.
explanation.tk:
-ing bilen gutarýan sözler dürli wezipeleri ýerine ýetirip biler:
• Işlik (continuous): She is SWIMMING now.
• At (gerund): SWIMMING is good for you. / I like READING.
• Sypat: a BORING film, an INTERESTING book, RUNNING water
-ing sypaty we -ed sypaty:
• -ing = bir zadyň täsiri: The film is boring (film içgysgynç).
• -ed = adamyň duýgusy: I am bored (meniň içim gysdy).
Ýazylyşy: make → making, run → running, lie → lying.
explanation.ru:
Слова на -ing выполняют разные функции:
• Глагол (continuous): She is SWIMMING now.
• Существительное (герундий): SWIMMING is good for you. / I like READING.
• Прилагательное: a BORING film, an INTERESTING book, RUNNING water
-ing vs -ed прилагательные:
• -ing = свойство предмета: The film is boring (фильм скучный).
• -ed = чувство человека: I am bored (мне скучно).
Написание: make → making, run → running, lie → lying.

examples.en: She is swimming in the sea.

examples.tk: Film içgysgynçdy, şonuň üçin meniň içim gysdy.
examples.ru: Фильм был скучным, и мне было скучно.
